branch.biome: any mountain except glacial and volcanic
branch.model: the dwarven isolate; no human analog

_note: Dwarven demihuman culture, the central mountain dialect of the Durn (family_dwarven.json) - the standard against which the fire (Gormdurn) and frost (Khraaldurn) dialects are measured. Hard, throaty, short-syllabled speech with a hammer-on-anvil rhythm (hard consonant frames, soft a/o/u vowels, geminates for the beat). An ancient vault-kingdom of clan-holds, golden-age now mostly fallen to fastness-holds. Predominantly Neutral, with a strong law-touch (the orderly vault-kingdoms): weights {Lawful 0.30, Neutral 0.60, Chaotic 0.10}. Seeds in any Mountain hex EXCEPT Glacial and Volcanic. Dwarven is an ISOLATE (not ancestral to any human family); the three dwarven cultures are DIALECTS with only small drift, so Khordurn's words are near-identical to Gormdurn's and Khraaldurn's. DEITY names are the Dwarven morphs of the Agrippan canon (never real Tolkien/Norse/Warhammer dwarf-gods); they take the shared sacred GENDERED ending -drumm (m) / -drumma (f) - the anvil-named suffix - distinct from mortal -un/-ar/-ok / -a/-na/-ra and the bare common-noun root.

phonology.palette: Khordurn (Durnkad central dialect): hard consonant frames (k/g/d/t/b/p, clusters dr/br/gr/kr/thr/rd/rg/rk/nd, geminates kk/gg/dd/mm/nn) around soft open vowels (a/o/u, some e/i); short, heavy CVC syllables with initial stress - rhythmic, like hammer-strokes, the soft vowels rolling a lilt between the hard beats.
phonology.phonotactics: CVC and short clusters; initial heavy stress; final stops and geminates carry the beat; few long vowels (those mark the Khraaldurn dialect).

morphology.patronymic_form: clan-primary: the clan (Kron [X]) by an ancestral line; an optional patronymic [parent]-kun (son of) / -ketta (daughter of); the forefather is named at every hearth.
morphology.compounding_rule: [material|quality](hard root) + feature/hold: Galdar-grund (gold-hold), Bral-grundar (forge-hall); -grund for the hold, Kron- for the clan.

title_ladder.government: feudal (an ancient vault-kingdom of clan-holds, now mostly fastness-holds; the Korrun under the mountain over the clan-lords, the rune-wardens and the hammer-companies)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Khordurn (central-dialect) reflexes of the Durnkad title ladder, ascending - the same seven ACKS tiers the Gormdurn and Khraaldurn share with only tiny drift. Borkun (clan-lord) barony; Vardrun (gate-warden) march; Grundar (delf-lord) county; Dramnar (great-lord) duchy; Brakkun (high-lord) principality; Korrun (king under the mountain) kingdom; Dur-Korrun (over-king) empire. A golden-age vault-kingdom, now fastness-holds.

vassalage.fealty: Durnoath (the deep-oath, sworn on the ancestors)

people_name_convention.order: a hard-short given name + the clan (Kron [X]); dwarves are named by clan and forefather; an optional patronymic -kun/-ketta.
people_name_convention.dual_register: every dwarf carries a clan-name and a forefather; the given name is plain and the clan is the pride.
people_name_convention.theophoric: mortal theophorics weave the honored power's ROOT (never the divine -drumm/-drumma ending) + a mortal ending: Orlun-ar (a smith named for the forge-god Orlundrumm), Gundun-a (a daughter named for the mountain-god).

religion._note: Deity-names are the Khordurn reflexes of the Dwarven morphs of the Agrippan canon (family_dwarven.json) - never real Tolkien/Norse/Warhammer dwarf-gods; they take the sacred GENDERED ending -drumm (masc) / -drumma (fem) - the anvil-named class, distinct from mortal -un/-ar/-ok / -a/-na/-ra and the common-noun root. ANCESTOR-CENTRIC: daily liturgy and prayer go to the honored dead (the durnad) and clan-fathers (fadrun) at the tomb-hall; the gods are honored at yearly/seasonal FESTIVALS, foremost the forge (Orlundrumm) and the mine/mountain (Gundundrumm). The drumgrund (festival-hall), loud with hammers on the feast-days, is where the gods are sung.
religion.the_one: Atrundrumm (< Aeternus; sacred-masculine ending -drumm; the Stone-Father, the First Shaper; honored at the great festivals but distant from the daily ancestor-prayers; revered most when Lawful)

Orlandus.gloss: the forge, the smith, oaths and iron; the most honored god, masc.

Gaiandus.gloss: the mountain, the mine, the deep earth; co-foremost, masc.

Delorum.gloss: death and the honored dead; the ancestor-warden, masc.

worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the dwarven norm: daily prayer to the honored dead (the durnad) and clan-fathers (fadrun) at the tomb-hall; the gods honored at yearly/seasonal festivals, foremost the forge (Orlundrumm) and the mountain/mine (Gundundrumm), the powers of fire and earth; the One and the rest acknowledged distantly
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: revere the One (Atrundrumm) and the Lawful powers (Orlundrumm the smith, Gundundrumm the mountain, Numundrumm), demonize the Chaotic powers
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: venerate the Chaotic fire- and greed-powers (Marakadrumm the forge-fire, Lusundrumm the gold-sickness), demonize the Lawful powers and the One

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the demonized set (by current alignment): when Lawful - Maraxus -> Marakadrumm the Wrack, Lusanto -> Lusundrumm the Gold-Sickness; when Chaotic - Aeternus -> Atrundrumm the Cold-Vault.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Drumgrund (festival-hall) of [power]: 'the Drumgrund of Orlundrumm', loud with hammers on the feast-days.
religion.saints_pattern: the honored forefathers and master-smiths of the clans (the durnad), named at every hearth and tomb.

holy_symbol_motifs.Orlundrumm: a hammer crossed over an anvil

banks_patterns.ships: (dwarves are no sailors) deep-barges and ore-rafts on the underflow: 'the Stone Keel', 'Hammer-of-the-Deep'
banks_patterns.military_units: the hold-wardens and hammer-companies: 'the Anvil Guard', 'the Iron-beards of [clan]'
banks_patterns.taverns: the ale-hall: 'the Hall of the Deep Ale', 'the Golden Tankard'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: fallen dwarf-holds and flooded delfs: 'the lost Hold of [clan]', 'the Drowned Delf of [name]'
